description: OKR tracking for Hamim: Daily (current month through yesterday) on top, Monthly (operating history through yesterday) below. Completed-only, Riyadh-anchored 'through yesterday'. See each card's description for definitions and omitted columns.

card.description: One row per day for the current Riyadh month up to yesterday. DoD deltas. Completed only (reservations.status=3; drafts status=30 and soft-deletes excluded). ORDER = completed pay-per-wash (use_package=0) OR paid package purchase (package_subscriptions.status=1); subscription-redemption washes (use_package=1) are excluded from ORDERS/customers but INCLUDED in Completed washes. New customer = first-ever completed order/wash falls in this period; Returning = had activity in a prior period. Sales(SAR) = pay-per-wash revenue (CAST(total_price)) + package cost. AOV=sales/orders, AOPU=orders/active-customers, ARPU=sales/active-customers. Washers available = distinct washers in attendances. Newest period on top (DESC). Through YESTERDAY only in Riyadh time: period < DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR) (DB server runs UTC, +3h anchors Asia/Riyadh); the current in-progress period never includes today. Each metric is followed by its change column: count/value metrics use % change, percentage-type metrics use percentage-point (pp) change, via LAG() over the ordered periods. OMITTED (not fabricated): launch2order conversion (only DB source market_report_snapshots is sparse/duplicated and ends 2026-07-04); CAC and CPO (need marketing spend, not in this DB); TTC within-month (no defined DB event); CSAT/ratings/issues (separate source, out of scope).
card.name: OKR — Daily (current month, through yesterday)

stages.native:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR,'%Y-%m-%d') today_str,
         DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR,'%Y-%m-01') mstart_str,
         DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR) today_d,
         DATE(DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR,'%Y-%m-01')) mstart_d
),
fa AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(actday) fa FROM (
    SELECT client_id, `date` actday FROM reservations
      WHERE status=3 AND use_package=0 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND `date` IS NOT NULL AND `date`<>''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT client_id, DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') FROM package_subscriptions
      WHERE status=1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
  ) u GROUP BY client_id
),
ou AS (
  SELECT `date` day, client_id, 0 is_pkg, CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) amount
    FROM reservations WHERE status=3 AND use_package=0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND `date` >= (SELECT mstart_str FROM bounds) AND `date` < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') day, client_id, 1 is_pkg, cost amount
    FROM package_subscriptions WHERE status=1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') >= (SELECT mstart_str FROM bounds)
      AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
),
ord AS (
  SELECT day, SUM(is_pkg) package_orders, SUM(1-is_pkg) single_orders,
         COUNT(*) total_orders, SUM(amount) sales_sar
  FROM ou GROUP BY day
),
ord_cust AS (
  SELECT o.day, o.client_id, MIN(f.fa) fa FROM ou o JOIN fa f ON f.client_id=o.client_id
  GROUP BY o.day, o.client_id
),
cust AS (
  SELECT day, COUNT(*) active_customers, SUM(fa=day) new_customers,
         COUNT(*)-SUM(fa=day) returning_customers
  FROM ord_cust GROUP BY day
),
wash AS (
  SELECT r.`date` day, COUNT(*) completed_washes,
         SUM(f.fa=r.`date`) washes_new_cust, COUNT(*)-SUM(f.fa=r.`date`) washes_returning_cust
  FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN fa f ON f.client_id=r.client_id
  WHERE r.status=3 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND r.`date` >= (SELECT mstart_str FROM bounds) AND r.`date` < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY r.`date`
),
sign AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') day, COUNT(*) signups
  FROM clients WHERE type=0
    AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') >= (SELECT mstart_str FROM bounds)
    AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY day
),
att AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`date`,'%Y-%m-%d') day, COUNT(DISTINCT representative_id) washers_available
  FROM attendances WHERE `date` >= (SELECT mstart_d FROM bounds) AND `date` < (SELECT today_d FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY day
),
days AS (
  SELECT day FROM ord UNION SELECT day FROM wash UNION SELECT day FROM cust
  UNION SELECT day FROM sign UNION SELECT day FROM att
),
base AS (
  SELECT d.day period,
    COALESCE(o.package_orders,0) package_orders, COALESCE(o.single_orders,0) single_orders,
    COALESCE(o.total_orders,0) total_orders, COALESCE(o.sales_sar,0) sales_sar,
    COALESCE(w.completed_washes,0) completed_washes, COALESCE(w.washes_new_cust,0) washes_new_cust,
    COALESCE(w.washes_returning_cust,0) washes_returning_cust,
    COALESCE(c.active_customers,0) active_customers, COALESCE(c.new_customers,0) new_customers,
    COALESCE(c.returning_customers,0) returning_customers, COALESCE(s.signups,0) signups,
    COALESCE(a.washers_available,0) washers_available
  FROM days d
  LEFT JOIN ord o ON o.day=d.day LEFT JOIN wash w ON w.day=d.day
  LEFT JOIN cust c ON c.day=d.day LEFT JOIN sign s ON s.day=d.day LEFT JOIN att a ON a.day=d.day
),
calc AS (
  SELECT period, package_orders, single_orders, total_orders,
    ROUND(100*package_orders/NULLIF(total_orders,0),1) package_pct,
    ROUND(100*single_orders/NULLIF(total_orders,0),1) single_pct,
    completed_washes, washes_new_cust, washes_returning_cust,
    ROUND(100*washes_returning_cust/NULLIF(completed_washes,0),1) returning_wash_pct,
    ROUND(completed_washes/NULLIF(total_orders,0),2) avg_washes_per_order,
    signups, new_customers, ROUND(100*new_customers/NULLIF(signups,0),1) activation_pct,
    returning_customers, active_customers,
    ROUND(100*returning_customers/NULLIF(active_customers,0),1) returning_pct,
    sales_sar, ROUND(sales_sar/NULLIF(total_orders,0),2) aov,
    ROUND(total_orders/NULLIF(active_customers,0),2) aopu,
    ROUND(sales_sar/NULLIF(active_customers,0),2) arpu,
    ROUND(completed_washes/NULLIF(washers_available,0),2) washes_per_washer,
    washers_available
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  period,
  package_orders,
  ROUND(100*(package_orders - LAG(package_orders) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(package_orders) OVER w,0),1) AS package_orders_dod,
  single_orders,
  ROUND(100*(single_orders - LAG(single_orders) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(single_orders) OVER w,0),1) AS single_orders_dod,
  total_orders,
  ROUND(100*(total_orders - LAG(total_orders) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(total_orders) OVER w,0),1) AS total_orders_dod,
  package_pct,
  ROUND(package_pct - LAG(package_pct) OVER w,1) AS package_pct_dod,
  single_pct,
  ROUND(single_pct - LAG(single_pct) OVER w,1) AS single_pct_dod,
  completed_washes,
  ROUND(100*(completed_washes - LAG(completed_washes) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(completed_washes) OVER w,0),1) AS completed_washes_dod,
  washes_new_cust,
  ROUND(100*(washes_new_cust - LAG(washes_new_cust) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washes_new_cust) OVER w,0),1) AS washes_new_cust_dod,
  washes_returning_cust,
  ROUND(100*(washes_returning_cust - LAG(washes_returning_cust) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washes_returning_cust) OVER w,0),1) AS washes_returning_cust_dod,
  returning_wash_pct,
  ROUND(returning_wash_pct - LAG(returning_wash_pct) OVER w,1) AS returning_wash_pct_dod,
  avg_washes_per_order,
  ROUND(100*(avg_washes_per_order - LAG(avg_washes_per_order) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(avg_washes_per_order) OVER w,0),1) AS avg_washes_per_order_dod,
  signups,
  ROUND(100*(signups - LAG(signups) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(signups) OVER w,0),1) AS signups_dod,
  new_customers,
  ROUND(100*(new_customers - LAG(new_customers) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(new_customers) OVER w,0),1) AS new_customers_dod,
  activation_pct,
  ROUND(activation_pct - LAG(activation_pct) OVER w,1) AS activation_pct_dod,
  returning_customers,
  ROUND(100*(returning_customers - LAG(returning_customers) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(returning_customers) OVER w,0),1) AS returning_customers_dod,
  active_customers,
  ROUND(100*(active_customers - LAG(active_customers) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(active_customers) OVER w,0),1) AS active_customers_dod,
  returning_pct,
  ROUND(returning_pct - LAG(returning_pct) OVER w,1) AS returning_pct_dod,
  sales_sar,
  ROUND(100*(sales_sar - LAG(sales_sar) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(sales_sar) OVER w,0),1) AS sales_sar_dod,
  aov,
  ROUND(100*(aov - LAG(aov) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(aov) OVER w,0),1) AS aov_dod,
  aopu,
  ROUND(100*(aopu - LAG(aopu) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(aopu) OVER w,0),1) AS aopu_dod,
  arpu,
  ROUND(100*(arpu - LAG(arpu) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(arpu) OVER w,0),1) AS arpu_dod,
  washes_per_washer,
  ROUND(100*(washes_per_washer - LAG(washes_per_washer) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washes_per_washer) OVER w,0),1) AS washes_per_washer_dod,
  washers_available,
  ROUND(100*(washers_available - LAG(washers_available) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washers_available) OVER w,0),1) AS washers_available_dod
FROM calc
WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY period ASC)
ORDER BY period DESC

stages.native:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR,'%Y-%m-%d') today_str,
         DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR) today_d
),
fa AS (
  SELECT client_id, MIN(actday) fa FROM (
    SELECT client_id, `date` actday FROM reservations
      WHERE status=3 AND use_package=0 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND `date` IS NOT NULL AND `date`<>''
    UNION ALL
    SELECT client_id, DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') FROM package_subscriptions
      WHERE status=1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
  ) u GROUP BY client_id
),
ou AS (
  SELECT LEFT(`date`,7) ym, client_id, 0 is_pkg, CAST(total_price AS DECIMAL(10,2)) amount
    FROM reservations WHERE status=3 AND use_package=0 AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND `date` IS NOT NULL AND `date`<>'' AND `date` < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') ym, client_id, 1 is_pkg, cost amount
    FROM package_subscriptions WHERE status=1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
      AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
),
ord AS (
  SELECT ym, SUM(is_pkg) package_orders, SUM(1-is_pkg) single_orders,
         COUNT(*) total_orders, SUM(amount) sales_sar FROM ou GROUP BY ym
),
ord_cust AS (
  SELECT o.ym, o.client_id, COUNT(*) cnt, MIN(f.fa) fa
  FROM ou o JOIN fa f ON f.client_id=o.client_id GROUP BY o.ym, o.client_id
),
cust AS (
  SELECT ym, COUNT(*) active_customers, SUM(LEFT(fa,7)=ym) new_customers,
         COUNT(*)-SUM(LEFT(fa,7)=ym) returning_customers,
         SUM(cnt>=2) repeat_customers
  FROM ord_cust GROUP BY ym
),
wash AS (
  SELECT LEFT(r.`date`,7) ym, COUNT(*) completed_washes,
         SUM(LEFT(f.fa,7)=LEFT(r.`date`,7)) washes_new_cust,
         COUNT(*)-SUM(LEFT(f.fa,7)=LEFT(r.`date`,7)) washes_returning_cust
  FROM reservations r LEFT JOIN fa f ON f.client_id=r.client_id
  WHERE r.status=3 AND r.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.`date` IS NOT NULL AND r.`date`<>''
    AND r.`date` < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY LEFT(r.`date`,7)
),
sign AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) signups
  FROM clients WHERE type=0 AND DATE_FORMAT(created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY ym
),
subren AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ps.created_at,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) paid_subs,
    SUM(EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM package_subscriptions p2 WHERE p2.client_id=ps.client_id
          AND p2.status=1 AND p2.deleted_at IS NULL AND p2.created_at<ps.created_at)) renewals
  FROM package_subscriptions ps WHERE ps.status=1 AND ps.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND DATE_FORMAT(ps.created_at,'%Y-%m-%d') < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY ym
),
att AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`date`,'%Y-%m') ym, COUNT(*) washer_days,
         COUNT(DISTINCT representative_id) washers_available
  FROM attendances WHERE `date` < (SELECT today_d FROM bounds) GROUP BY ym
),
months AS (
  -- operating months only: anchor to real order/wash activity (first ops = 2023-10),
  -- excludes a few pre-launch months that had only scattered signups and zero orders/washes
  SELECT ym FROM ord UNION SELECT ym FROM wash
),
base AS (
  SELECT m.ym period,
    COALESCE(o.package_orders,0) package_orders, COALESCE(o.single_orders,0) single_orders,
    COALESCE(o.total_orders,0) total_orders, COALESCE(o.sales_sar,0) sales_sar,
    COALESCE(w.completed_washes,0) completed_washes, COALESCE(w.washes_new_cust,0) washes_new_cust,
    COALESCE(w.washes_returning_cust,0) washes_returning_cust,
    COALESCE(c.active_customers,0) active_customers, COALESCE(c.new_customers,0) new_customers,
    COALESCE(c.returning_customers,0) returning_customers, COALESCE(c.repeat_customers,0) repeat_customers,
    COALESCE(s.signups,0) signups, COALESCE(a.washers_available,0) washers_available,
    COALESCE(a.washer_days,0) washer_days,
    COALESCE(sr.paid_subs,0) paid_subs, COALESCE(sr.renewals,0) renewals
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN ord o ON o.ym=m.ym LEFT JOIN wash w ON w.ym=m.ym LEFT JOIN cust c ON c.ym=m.ym
  LEFT JOIN sign s ON s.ym=m.ym LEFT JOIN att a ON a.ym=m.ym LEFT JOIN subren sr ON sr.ym=m.ym
),
calc AS (
  SELECT period, package_orders, single_orders, total_orders,
    ROUND(100*package_orders/NULLIF(total_orders,0),1) package_pct,
    ROUND(100*single_orders/NULLIF(total_orders,0),1) single_pct,
    completed_washes, washes_new_cust, washes_returning_cust,
    ROUND(100*washes_returning_cust/NULLIF(completed_washes,0),1) returning_wash_pct,
    ROUND(completed_washes/NULLIF(total_orders,0),2) avg_washes_per_order,
    signups, new_customers, ROUND(100*new_customers/NULLIF(signups,0),1) activation_pct,
    returning_customers, active_customers,
    ROUND(100*returning_customers/NULLIF(active_customers,0),1) returning_pct,
    sales_sar, ROUND(sales_sar/NULLIF(total_orders,0),2) aov,
    ROUND(total_orders/NULLIF(active_customers,0),2) aopu,
    ROUND(sales_sar/NULLIF(active_customers,0),2) arpu,
    ROUND(completed_washes/NULLIF(washer_days,0),2) washes_per_washer, washers_available,
    repeat_customers, ROUND(100*repeat_customers/NULLIF(active_customers,0),1) within_month_repeat_pct,
    renewals, ROUND(100*renewals/NULLIF(paid_subs,0),1) subscription_renewal_pct
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  period,
  package_orders,
  ROUND(100*(package_orders - LAG(package_orders) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(package_orders) OVER w,0),1) AS package_orders_mom,
  single_orders,
  ROUND(100*(single_orders - LAG(single_orders) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(single_orders) OVER w,0),1) AS single_orders_mom,
  total_orders,
  ROUND(100*(total_orders - LAG(total_orders) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(total_orders) OVER w,0),1) AS total_orders_mom,
  package_pct,
  ROUND(package_pct - LAG(package_pct) OVER w,1) AS package_pct_mom,
  single_pct,
  ROUND(single_pct - LAG(single_pct) OVER w,1) AS single_pct_mom,
  completed_washes,
  ROUND(100*(completed_washes - LAG(completed_washes) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(completed_washes) OVER w,0),1) AS completed_washes_mom,
  washes_new_cust,
  ROUND(100*(washes_new_cust - LAG(washes_new_cust) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washes_new_cust) OVER w,0),1) AS washes_new_cust_mom,
  washes_returning_cust,
  ROUND(100*(washes_returning_cust - LAG(washes_returning_cust) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washes_returning_cust) OVER w,0),1) AS washes_returning_cust_mom,
  returning_wash_pct,
  ROUND(returning_wash_pct - LAG(returning_wash_pct) OVER w,1) AS returning_wash_pct_mom,
  avg_washes_per_order,
  ROUND(100*(avg_washes_per_order - LAG(avg_washes_per_order) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(avg_washes_per_order) OVER w,0),1) AS avg_washes_per_order_mom,
  signups,
  ROUND(100*(signups - LAG(signups) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(signups) OVER w,0),1) AS signups_mom,
  new_customers,
  ROUND(100*(new_customers - LAG(new_customers) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(new_customers) OVER w,0),1) AS new_customers_mom,
  activation_pct,
  ROUND(activation_pct - LAG(activation_pct) OVER w,1) AS activation_pct_mom,
  returning_customers,
  ROUND(100*(returning_customers - LAG(returning_customers) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(returning_customers) OVER w,0),1) AS returning_customers_mom,
  active_customers,
  ROUND(100*(active_customers - LAG(active_customers) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(active_customers) OVER w,0),1) AS active_customers_mom,
  returning_pct,
  ROUND(returning_pct - LAG(returning_pct) OVER w,1) AS returning_pct_mom,
  sales_sar,
  ROUND(100*(sales_sar - LAG(sales_sar) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(sales_sar) OVER w,0),1) AS sales_sar_mom,
  aov,
  ROUND(100*(aov - LAG(aov) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(aov) OVER w,0),1) AS aov_mom,
  aopu,
  ROUND(100*(aopu - LAG(aopu) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(aopu) OVER w,0),1) AS aopu_mom,
  arpu,
  ROUND(100*(arpu - LAG(arpu) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(arpu) OVER w,0),1) AS arpu_mom,
  washes_per_washer,
  ROUND(100*(washes_per_washer - LAG(washes_per_washer) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washes_per_washer) OVER w,0),1) AS washes_per_washer_mom,
  washers_available,
  ROUND(100*(washers_available - LAG(washers_available) OVER w)/NULLIF(LAG(washers_available) OVER w,0),1) AS washers_available_mom,
  repeat_customers,

card.description: North Star trend (DAILY). washes_per_washer_day = completed washes that day (reservations.status=3, drafts/deleted excluded) / washers active that day (COUNT(DISTINCT representative_id) in attendances), the SAME definition as the Daily OKR card (496). Daily series ascending, trailing ~30 days; big number = yesterday, arrow = day-over-day vs the day before. Cut at yesterday, Riyadh (date < DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR)). Benchmark goal ~4.0/day, break-even ~6.
card.name: North Star · Washes per Washer per Day

stages.native:
WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR,'%Y-%m-%d') today_str,
         DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR) today_d,
         DATE_FORMAT(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR - INTERVAL 30 DAY,'%Y-%m-%d') start_str,
         DATE(UTC_TIMESTAMP()+INTERVAL 3 HOUR - INTERVAL 30 DAY) start_d
),
wash AS (
  SELECT `date` day, COUNT(*) completed_washes
  FROM reservations
  WHERE status=3 AND deleted_at IS NULL AND `date` IS NOT NULL AND `date`<>''
    AND `date` >= (SELECT start_str FROM bounds) AND `date` < (SELECT today_str FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY `date`
),
att AS (
  SELECT DATE_FORMAT(`date`,'%Y-%m-%d') day, COUNT(DISTINCT representative_id) washers_available
  FROM attendances
  WHERE `date` >= (SELECT start_d FROM bounds) AND `date` < (SELECT today_d FROM bounds)
  GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(`date`,'%Y-%m-%d')
)
SELECT CAST(w.day AS DATE) AS date,
       ROUND(w.completed_washes/NULLIF(a.washers_available,0),2) AS washes_per_washer_day
FROM wash w JOIN att a ON a.day=w.day
WHERE a.washers_available > 0
ORDER BY date ASC;

name: Hamim · OKR Tracking
